title: Peekskill Middle School reports 31 multiracial students enrolled for 2025-26
text:
The 2025-26 school year at Peekskill Middle School saw enrollment of 31 multiracial students, representing a 24% increase compared with the prior year, as reported by the New York State Education Department .
Enrollment data indicated a total student body of 821 at Peekskill Middle School for 2025-26. Multiracial students made up 3.8% of those enrolled, ranking as the third least represented ethnicity at the school.
This campus is part of the Peekskill City School District, which is headquartered in Peekskill.
Peekskill High School registered the district’s largest number of multiracial students at that time, with 34 students enrolled.
New York places second in U.S. K-12 public education spending , with average expenditures at $30,012 per pupil, close to double the national average of $16,526, according to the Education Data Initiative.
